rounds.q: How much does Costco's hot dog and soda combo cost, in cents?
rounds.why: The price hasn't changed since 1985. Costco sold about 199 million hot dogs in 2023.
rounds.fun: The most loyal price in America!

rounds.q: How many calories are in a 12-oz can of Coca-Cola?
rounds.why: Every one of those calories comes from sugar: 39 grams per can.
rounds.fun: Basically a candy bar you sip.

rounds.q: What's the record for hot dogs eaten in 10 minutes?
rounds.why: Joey Chestnut set it in 2021. That's one hot dog, bun included, about every 8 seconds.
rounds.src: Nathan's Famous contest, via NBC News (2021)
rounds.fun: His jaw deserves its own trophy!

rounds.q: How many pounds of cheese does the average American eat in a year?
rounds.why: Mozzarella (12.5 lbs) beats cheddar (10.9 lbs) as America's favorite.
rounds.fun: About 40 pounds of cheese each. Say cheese!

rounds.q: How many pounds of chicken does one American eat in a year?
rounds.why: Chicken is the most-eaten meat in the US, ahead of beef and pork.
rounds.fun: That's a whole lot of nuggets!
